{{Top|leg}}
'''Waha plants''' were a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] grown in the temple of the [[White Current/Legends|White Current's]] bathing pool on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Pydyr]]. When [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] received the call from [[Raynar Thul|UnuThul]], he could smell the aroma from the waha plants nearby.
